verdict.rationale: Tavily publishes a per-endpoint API reference covering search, extract, crawl, map, research, usage and logs, and its docs and SDK README include copy-paste code examples. Keyless mode lets search() and extract() examples run without an API key. However, nothing in the pack shows the reference itself is interactive (no in-browser playground or 'try it' panel), and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on all candidate paths. Missing for 10: evidence of an interactive in-browser API explorer/playground, a published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.
